name: sae-measure-seeds
title: SAE map-gen seed harness (test tool, never shipped)
author: Liam Stannard
description: Loaded only by tools/client/measure-seeds/measure.py (a headless server, over RCON) and rings.py (a client through tools/client/launch.sh). Generates a planet's surface on given seeds and measures the nearest pool and the starting patches round the landing; in a client, screenshots the landing with distance rings drawn.
